claude_proposed_widenings.name: PassiveOperation.trigger.spell_save_outcome
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The ring needs an always-on, no-action listener on a successful spell save to apply `negate_triggering_spell`. Existing non-spell passives only support elapsed-time operations, and `triggered_reaction` would falsely charge a reaction for the automatic negation clause.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you succeed on the save for a spell of level 7 or lower, the spell has no effect on you.
